    t1.opsregistry AS operation_id,
    t2.coordeffectlvl AS performance_efficiency_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN t2.coordeffectlvl = 'High' THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'

    operations AS t1

    coordinationandevaluation AS t2

ORDER BY

events.sql:
SELECT 
    t1.opsregistry AS operation_id,
    t2.coordeffectlvl AS performance_efficiency_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN t2.coordeffectlvl = 'High' THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS meets_excellence_criteria
FROM 
    operations AS t1
JOIN 
    coordinationandevaluation AS t2
ON 
    t1.opsregistry = t2.coordopsref
ORDER BY 
    t2.coordeffectlvl DESC;
